checks.label: At 8 quarters the tail is 2 m and 24 ÷ 8 = 3 tails fit, the puzzle’s first cut; at 3 quarters, 3/4 m, 24 ÷ 3 = 8, its second; both use all 6 m
At 4 quarters the tail is 1 m and 24 ÷ 4 = 6 tails fit, one per metre; every shorter tail fits more than 6 times, every longer one fewer
Where 24 does not divide evenly: at 5 quarters 24 ÷ 5 = 4.8, four whole tails of 1 1/4 m use 5 m and 1 m is left; at 7, about 3.43, three tails of 1 3/4 m use 5.25 m and 0.75 m is left
"3 divided by 1/4" asks how many quarters are in 3, which is 12
The reciprocal counts how many times the fraction fits into 1: a 3/4 m tail fits 4/3 times, about 1.33, into 1 m
The dots fall steeply then flatten: from 1 quarter to 2 the count drops by 12, from 7 to 8 by about 0.43; and whole tails plus the cable left over always give the 6 m back
